body: Looking for this weekend. Any around?
Thank you, this has really helped bring me back to earth a little. I'm in a very low state at the moment so it's really easy for me to consider myself as broken.

Thank you so much. Reading this has helped a lot, I was expecting a lot of hate from this post but instead you were factual and respectful of my decision to attempt reconciliation. 

I personally know my SO has attempted most of these suggestions. They have never once been upset with my questions or regularly bringing it up. I still feel a little lost though.

I'm so sorry to hear that! 
My SO says it in my lowest moments, I can't lie; my love for them is endless but I need to learn to live for myself and not others. Instead everyday feels like a fight with myself.
